summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the new Perplexity-style Company Research feature for RISEDUALAI. Backend: 7/7 tests passed (GET /api/research/{symbol} returns symbol, company_name, overview, synthesis, sources, news_count). minor.issue: Alpha Vantage rate limit (5 calls/min) causes overview to return None and company_name to fallback to symbol only. This is expected behavior with free tier API.
